contexts.text: Of the Church when vastated it is predicated that it shall stagger like a drunken man, etc. (). AE 304:4.
They stagger, but not with strong drink (). Explained. AE 376:32.
At the presence of a little child they reeled... with anguish. SE 3586.
They shall reel to and fro (). Explained.
He who ascends from a lower Heaven... falters in his voice...
To stagger in judgment () = senselessness. AE 260:end. ( = that they do not see the truths which belong to intelligence. AE 376:31.)
